# Equation 1
A workshop welder takes two parts, in a definite order, and fuses them into one new part. Feeding the same two parts in the opposite order, or grouping a sequence of welds differently, may give a different part.

Claim: for any part x, x gives the same part as x.

# Equation 2
A workshop welder takes two parts, in a definite order, and fuses them into one new part. Feeding the same two parts in the opposite order, or grouping a sequence of welds differently, may give a different part.

Claim: for any parts x and y, x gives the same part as y.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding y to y to the part made by welding y to z.

Claim: for any parts x, y, z, w and u, welding x to y gives the same part as welding z to the part made by welding w to u.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding y to the part made by welding x to the part made by welding the part made by welding z to x to y.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding y to the part made by welding z to the part made by welding the part made by welding y to z to z.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding y to the part made by welding the part made by welding y to z to the part made by welding x to y.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding x to the part made by welding the part made by welding the part made by welding y to x to z to z.

Claim: for any parts x and y, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding x to y to the part made by welding the part made by welding x to x to y.

Claim: for any parts x, y, z and w, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding x to the part made by welding y to the part made by welding z to w to x.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding y to the part made by welding z to the part made by welding x to x to y.

Claim: for any parts x and y, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding x to the part made by welding the part made by welding x to x to y to y.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding the part made by welding x to y to the part made by welding z to y to y.

Claim: for any parts x, y, z and w, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding the part made by welding y to y to the part made by welding z to z to w.

Claim: for any parts x, y, z, w and u, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding the part made by welding y to z to the part made by welding w to u to z.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding the part made by welding the part made by welding x to y to y to z to z.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, x gives the same part as welding the part made by welding the part made by welding the part made by welding y to y to z to y to x.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, welding x to y gives the same part as welding x to the part made by welding z to the part made by welding x to x.

Claim: for any parts x, y, z and w, welding x to y gives the same part as welding z to the part made by welding y to the part made by welding w to x.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, welding x to x gives the same part as welding y to the part made by welding the part made by welding z to x to x.

Claim: for any parts x, y, z, w and u, welding x to y gives the same part as welding z to the part made by welding the part made by welding w to u to u.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, welding x to y gives the same part as welding the part made by welding z to the part made by welding x to x to z.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, welding x to y gives the same part as welding the part made by welding the part made by welding y to x to x to z.

Claim: for any parts x, y, z and w, welding x to y gives the same part as welding the part made by welding the part made by welding z to z to w to z.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, welding x to the part made by welding y to x gives the same part as welding y to the part made by welding x to z.

Claim: for any parts x and y, welding x to the part made by welding x to y gives the same part as welding the part made by welding y to x to x.

Claim: for any parts x, y, z, w and u, welding x to the part made by welding y to z gives the same part as welding the part made by welding w to z to u.

Claim: for any parts x, y and z, welding the part made by welding x to y to y gives the same part as welding the part made by welding x to y to z.
